row = net: one signal, power or ground n: row = net: one signal, power or ground net.
speed in Hz: 400k, 8 MHz, 115200. Se: speed in Hz: 400k, 8 MHz, 115200. Several driver parts separated by ;, or none for a net without a driver.
reference: the intended return refer: reference: the intended return reference, such as GND on In1. target: an impedance or length target.
row = load: one load on a power rail.
net: the rail. voltage in V: 3.3 or: net: the rail. voltage in V: 3.3 or 3V3. Currents: 150mA, or amps such as 0.15.
pours: the nets poured on it. splits: pours: the nets poured on it. splits: intentional splits and star grounds.
Leave a cell blank when it does not appl: Leave a cell blank when it does not apply or is not known; a column the file leaves out is blank in every row.
